# Crop soil
## Alpha diversity
```{r}
ps_tf <- subset_samples(ps_consensus, sampling_time == "tf")
ps_agri <- subset_samples(ps_tf, soil == "a")

nbragri <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_agri) > 0, ps_agri)

ntaxa(nbragri) #363
nsamples(ps_agri)  # Number of samples 30

#alpha diveristy
alpha_divagri <- estimate_richness(ps_agri, measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Observed", "Chao1"))

# metadata
metadataagri <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_agri))

# Merge alpha diveristy and metadata
alpha_divagri<- cbind(metadataagri, alpha_divagri)

#Coefficent of variation
alpha_divagri %>% filter(treatment == "ctl") %>%
summarise(CV = (sd(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100) #20.71

```

## Recap table alpha div
```{r}
resume_alpha_agri <- alpha_divagri %>%
group_by(treatment) %>%

Shannon_moy = mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),

resume_alpha_agri
```

## Kruskal-Wallis alpha diversity
```{r}
library(FSA)

indices <- c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Observed", "Chao1")
variables <- c("block", "treatment")

resultats_kw_agri <- expand_grid(indice = indices, variable = variables) %>%
rowwise() %>%
mutate(p_value = kruskal.test(as.formula(paste(indice, "~", variable)), data = alpha_divagri)$p.value) %>%
ungroup() %>%
group_by(variable) %>%
mutate(p_corrigee = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
ungroup()

resultats_kw_agri

# Posthoc
dunnshannon<-dunnTest(Shannon ~ treatment, data = alpha_divagri, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

dunnsimpson<-dunnTest(Simpson ~ treatment, data = alpha_divagri, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

dunnobs<-dunnTest(Observed ~ treatment, data = alpha_divagri, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

dunnchao<-dunnTest(Chao1 ~ treatment, data = alpha_divagri, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

# crop soil color
colors_treatment <- c(
"ctl"    = "grey70", 
"10^-08" = "#FEE6CE",  
"10^-06" = "#FDAE6B",  
"10^-04" = "#FD8D3C",  
"10^-02" = "#E6550D",  
"10^-0"  = "#A63603")

treatment_names <- c(
"ctl"    = "CTL", 
"10^-08" = "D8",  
"10^-06" = "D6",  
"10^-04" = "D4",  
"10^-02" = "D2",  
"10^-0"  = "D0")


lettres_shannon <- data.frame(treatment = c("10^-0", "10^-02", "10^-04", "10^-06", "10^-08", "ctl"),
lettre = c("a", "a", "ab", "b", "b", "b"),
y = c(4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4)) 

shannonagri <- ggplot(alpha_divagri, aes(x=treatment, y=Shannon, fill=treatment, color=treatment)) +  
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) + 
geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2)+
scale_fill_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +

scale_x_discrete(labels=treatment_names) +
theme_minimal() +
labs(x="", y="Shannon diversity index") +
theme( legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0)) + 
geom_text(data = lettres_shannon, aes(x = treatment, y = y, label = lettre), inherit.aes = FALSE)

simpsonagri <- ggplot(alpha_divagri, aes(x=treatment, y=Simpson, fill=treatment, color=treatment)) +  
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) +

scale_color_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_x_discrete(labels=treatment_names) +
```

## Correlation alpha diversity & enzyme
```{r}

enzyme <- enzyme %>% mutate(sample = paste0("tf", sample))

enzymeagri <- enzyme %>% filter(soil == "agricole")

#Remove CTL because it doesnt make sens to keep it.
enzyme_agri <- enzymeagri %>% filter(treatment != 0)

alpha_divagri <- alpha_divagri %>% filter (treatment!= "ctl")

div_enzyme <- alpha_divagri %>%
left_join(enzyme_agri, by = "sample")

div_indices <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
enzymes <- c("Protease", "Desaminase", "Bglucosidase","Ammonification", "Nitrification")

cor_results <- div_enzyme %>%
pivot_longer(cols = all_of(div_indices), names_to = "Diversity_index", values_to = "Diversity_value") %>%
pivot_longer(cols = all_of(enzymes), names_to = "Enzyme", values_to = "Enzyme_activity") %>%
group_by(Diversity_index, Enzyme) %>%
cor_test(Diversity_value, Enzyme_activity, method = "spearman") %>%
ungroup() %>%
adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
add_significance("p.adj")

write_xlsx(cor_results, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/correlationalpha_crop_synthetic_16s.xlsx")

# Results prep
plot_cor <- cor_results %>%
mutate(Diversity_index = factor(Diversity_index, levels = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")),
Enzyme = factor(Enzyme, levels = c("Protease", "Desaminase", "Bglucosidase", "Ammonification", "Nitrification")),
significance = case_when(p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**", p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""))


# Heatmap to make figure S4
corr_alpha_crop_16s <-ggplot(plot_cor, aes(x = Enzyme, y = Diversity_index, fill = cor)) +
geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", p.adj)), size = 3.5)+
scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#FDAE6B", mid = "white", high = "#A63603", midpoint = 0,
limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman's rho") +
labs(x = "Fonction measured", y = "Alpha diversity index") +
theme_minimal() +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())

saveRDS(corr_alpha_crop_16s, "corr_alpha_crop_16s.rds")

```

## Beta diversity 
```{r}

# Abundance table
otu_agri <- as(otu_table(ps_agri), "matrix")

# In line
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_agri)) {
  otu_agri <- t(otu_agri)}

#  Hellinger
ps_hellingeragri <- decostand(otu_agri, method = "hellinger")

#  Eucledian distance 
dist_hellingeragri <- vegdist(ps_hellingeragri, diag=TRUE, upper=FALSE, method = "euclidean")

metadataagri <- sample_data(ps_agri)
metadata_dfagri <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_agri))
metadata_dfagri$block <-as.factor(metadata_dfagri$block)
metadata_dfagri$treatment <-as.factor(metadata_dfagri$treatment)

# Homogeneity of multivariate dispersions
betadisper_resultagri <- betadisper(dist_hellingeragri, group = metadata_dfagri$treatment)

plot(betadisper_resultagri)
anova_res <- anova(betadisper_resultagri) #p-value 0.00006082 ***

# Extract values
F_value <- anova_res$`F value`[1]
p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]

# Dispersion table
df_disp <- data.frame(sample = names(betadisper_resultagri$distances), distance = betadisper_resultagri$distances, group = metadata_dfagri$treatment)

table_disp <- df_disp %>%
group_by(group) %>%
summarise(n = n(),mean_dispersion = mean(distance), sd = sd(distance), se = sd / sqrt(n), .groups = "drop"
) %>%
mutate(F_value = F_value, p_anova = p_anova)

# Tukey post-hoc
tukey_res <- TukeyHSD(betadisper_resultagri)
tukey_table <- as.data.frame(tukey_res$group)
tukey_table$comparison <- rownames(tukey_table)
rownames(tukey_table) <- NULL

tukey_table <- tukey_table %>%
rename(diff = diff, lower = lwr, upper = upr,'p_adj' = `p adj`)


kruskal.test(df_disp$distance ~ df_disp$group)
#p-value = 0.002047

dunndisp_agri<-dunnTest(distance ~ group, data = df_disp, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

lettres_dispagri <- data.frame(
treatment = c("10^-0", "10^-02", "10^-04", "10^-06", "10^-08", "ctl"),
lettre = c("a", "a", "ab", "ab", "b", "b"),
y = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1))

beta_dispagri <- ggplot(df_disp, aes(x = group, y = distance, fill = group, color=group)) +
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) +
geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2)+
scale_fill_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_color_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_x_discrete(labels=treatment_names)+ 
labs(x = "", y = "Distance to centroid") + theme_minimal() + theme( legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0)) + geom_text(data = lettres_dispagri, aes(x = treatment, y = y, label = lettre), inherit.aes = FALSE)


library(vegan)
set.seed(18575748)  
permanova_agri <-adonis2(dist_hellingeragri ~ treatment, data = metadata_dfagri, permutations = 999, by="terms", strata = metadata_dfagri$block)

print(permanova_agri)
#            Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
#treatment  5   8.6834 0.43279 3.6624  0.001 ***
#Residual  24  11.3805 0.56721                  
#Total     29  20.0640 1.00000  

permanovaagri_out <- permanova_agri %>%
tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Variable")
write_xlsx(permanovaagri_out, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/permanova_crop_synthetic_16s.xlsx")

```

# Raup-Crick
```{r}
library(vegan)
ps_agri <- subset_samples(ps_agri, treatment != "ctl")

# Abundance
otu_rc <- as(otu_table(ps_agri), "matrix")

# In line
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_agri)) {
  otu_rc <- t(otu_rc)}

# Remove sample without reads
otu_rc <- otu_rc[rowSums(otu_rc) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

# Raup-Crick
set.seed(123)
dist_rc_agri <- raupcrick(comm = otu_rc, null = "r1", nsimul = 9999)

summary(as.vector(dist_rc_agri))
range(as.vector(dist_rc_agri))

# Aligne metadata with sample
metadataagri <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_agri))
metadataagri <- metadataagri[rownames(otu_rc), , drop = FALSE]

metadataagri$treatment <- factor(metadataagri$treatment)
metadataagri$block <- factor(metadataagri$block)

# Homogeneity of multivariate dispersions
betadisper_rc_agri <- betadisper(dist_rc_agri, group = metadataagri$treatment)
plot(betadisper_rc_agri)
anova_res_rc <- anova(betadisper_rc_agri) #p-value 0.02211 *

adonis2(dist_rc_agri ~ treatment, data = metadataagri, permutations = 999, by="terms", strata = metadataagri$block)
#          Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
#treatment  4   3.9340 0.86985 33.417  0.001 ***
#Residual  20   0.5886 0.13015                  
#Total     24   4.5226 1.00000  

```

##Linear model raup-crick
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(lmtest)
enzyme_agri_filtre <- div_enzyme %>%
filter(sample %in% metadataagri$sample) %>%
slice(match(metadataagri$sample, sample))

pcoa_rc <- cmdscale(dist_rc_agri, k = 5, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)

# Sample coordinate
site_scores <- pcoa_rc$points

# ASVs Scores
asv_scores <- wascores(site_scores, otu_rc, expand = TRUE)

asv_scores_df <- as.data.frame(asv_scores) %>% rownames_to_column("ASV")

asv_table <- asv_scores_df %>% left_join(asv_16s_mapping, by = "ASV")

top_asv <- bind_rows(
asv_table %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V1), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA1"),
asv_table %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V2), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA2"),
asv_table %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V3), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA3"),
asv_table %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V4), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA4"),
asv_table %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V5), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA5"))


pcoa_rc <- data.frame(SampleID = metadataagri$sample,
PCoA1 = pcoa_rc$points[, 1],
PCoA2 = pcoa_rc$points[, 2],
PCoA3 = pcoa_rc$points[, 3],
PCoA4 = pcoa_rc$points[, 4],
PCoA5 = pcoa_rc$points[, 5],
treatment = metadataagri$treatment,
block = metadataagri$block,
shannon = enzyme_agri_filtre$Shannon,
observed = enzyme_agri_filtre$Observed,
protease = enzyme_agri_filtre$Protease,
bgluco = enzyme_agri_filtre$Bglucosidase,
deaminase = enzyme_agri_filtre$Desaminase,
ammonif = enzyme_agri_filtre$Ammonification,
nitrif = enzyme_agri_filtre$Nitrification)

X <- as.matrix(pcoa_rc[, grep("PCoA", names(pcoa_rc))])
protease <- pcoa_rc$protease
bgluco <- pcoa_rc$bgluco
des <- pcoa_rc$deaminase
ammonif <-pcoa_rc$ammonif
nitrif<-  pcoa_rc$nitrif
shannon <- pcoa_rc$shannon
obs <- pcoa_rc$observed
block <- pcoa_rc$block

#Protease
prot_lm_b <- lm(sqrt(protease)~ X +obs)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(prot_lm_b)

# Residual Normality
shapiro.test(residuals(prot_lm_b))
#p-value = 0.7363

#homoscedasticity
bptest(prot_lm_b)
#p-value= 0.6864

summary(prot_lm_b)
#p-value 0.7494

#Bglucosidase
bgluco_lm_b <- lm(bgluco~ X + obs)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(bgluco_lm_b)

# Residual Normality
shapiro.test(residuals(bgluco_lm_b))
#p-value = 0.1742

#homoscedasticity
bptest(bgluco_lm_b)
#p-value= 0.5295

summary(bgluco_lm_b)
#p-value 0.882

#Deaminases
des_lm_b <- lm(sqrt(des)~ X + obs )

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(des_lm_b)

#Residual Normality
shapiro.test(residuals(des_lm_b))
#p-value = 0.001191

#homoscedasticity
bptest(des_lm_b)
#p-value= 0.2189

summary(des_lm_b)
#p-value 0.4534

#Ammonification
ammonif_lm_b <- lm(sqrt(ammonif)~ X+obs)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(ammonif_lm_b)

#Residual Normality
shapiro.test(residuals(ammonif_lm_b))
#p-value = 0.4429

#homoscedasticity
bptest(ammonif_lm_b)
#p-value= 0.1411

summary(ammonif_lm_b)
#p-value 0.1567

#Nitrification
nitrif_lm_b <- lm(sqrt(nitrif)~ X +obs)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(nitrif_lm_b)

#Residual Normality
shapiro.test(residuals(nitrif_lm_b))
#p-value = 0.261

#homoscedasticity
bptest(nitrif_lm_b)
#p-value= 0.3286

summary(nitrif_lm_b)
#p-value 0.4559


# Models list 
model_rc <- list(
protease = prot_lm_b,
bgluco = bgluco_lm_b,
des = des_lm_b,
ammonif = ammonif_lm_b,
nitrif = nitrif_lm_b)

# Coefficients
coef_table <- bind_rows(lapply(names(model_rc), function(name) {
tidy(model_rc[[name]]) %>%
mutate(response = name)})) %>%
dplyr::select(response, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value)

# Statistic
model_stats <- bind_rows(lapply(names(model_rc), function(name) {
glance(model_rc[[name]]) %>%
mutate(response = name)})) %>%
dplyr::select(response, r.squared, adj.r.squared, statistic, p.value, AIC, BIC)


#Clean
coef_table <- coef_table %>%
dplyr::select(response, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value)

model_stats <- model_stats %>%
dplyr::select(response, r.squared, adj.r.squared, statistic, p.value, AIC, BIC)

write_xlsx(list(
Coefficients = coef_table,
Model_Summary = model_stats),
path = "synthetic_soil/Results/lm_rp_obs_summaries_16S_crop_synthetic.xlsx")
```

## Kruskal-Wallis alpha diversity
```{r}
library(FSA)

indices <- c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Observed", "Chao1")
variables <- c("block", "treatment")

resultats_kw_fo <- expand_grid(indice = indices, variable = variables) %>%
rowwise() %>%
mutate(p_value = kruskal.test(as.formula(paste(indice, "~", variable)), data = alpha_divfo)$p.value) %>%
ungroup() %>%
group_by(variable) %>%
mutate(p_corrigee = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
ungroup()
```

## Correlation alpha diversity & enzyme
```{r}
enzymefo <- enzyme %>% filter(soil == "forestier")

#Remove CTL because it doesnt make sens to keep it.
enzyme_fo <- enzymefo %>% filter(treatment != 0)

alpha_divfo <- alpha_divfo %>% filter(treatment != "ctl")

div_enzyme <- alpha_divfo %>%
left_join(enzyme_fo, by = "sample")

div_indices <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
enzymes <- c("Protease", "Desaminase", "Bglucosidase","Ammonification", "Nitrification")

cor_resultsfo <- div_enzyme %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(div_indices), names_to = "Diversity_index", values_to = "Diversity_value") %>%
pivot_longer(cols = all_of(enzymes), names_to = "Enzyme", values_to = "Enzyme_activity") %>%
group_by(Diversity_index, Enzyme) %>%
cor_test(Diversity_value, Enzyme_activity, method = "spearman") %>%
ungroup() %>%
adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
add_significance("p.adj")


write_xlsx(cor_resultsfo, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/correlationalpha_forest_synthetic_16s.xlsx")

# Prep results
plot_cor_fo <- cor_resultsfo %>%
mutate(Diversity_index = factor(Diversity_index, levels = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")),
Enzyme = factor(Enzyme, levels = c("Protease", "Desaminase", "Bglucosidase","Ammonification", "Nitrification")), significance = case_when( p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**", p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""))


# Heatmap
corr_alpha_forest_16s <-ggplot(plot_cor_fo, aes(x = Enzyme, y = Diversity_index, fill = cor)) +
geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", p.adj)), size = 3.5)+
scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#BAE4B3", mid = "white", high = "#006D2C", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman's rho") +
labs(x = "Fonction measured", y = "Alpha diversity index") +
theme_minimal() +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())

saveRDS(corr_alpha_forest_16s, "corr_alpha_forest_16s.rds")
```

## Beta diversity 
```{r}
# Abundance table
otu_fo <- as(otu_table(ps_fo), "matrix")

# In line
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_fo)) {
  otu_fo <- t(otu_fo)}

#Hellinger
ps_hellingerfo <- decostand(otu_fo, method = "hellinger")

# Euclidien distance 
dist_hellingerfo <- vegdist(ps_hellingerfo, diag=TRUE, upper=FALSE, method = "euclidean")

# Extract metadata
metadatafo <- sample_data(ps_fo)
metadata_dffo <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_fo))
metadata_dffo$block <-as.factor(metadata_dffo$block)
metadata_dffo$treatment <-as.factor(metadata_dffo$treatment)

betadisper_resultfo <- betadisper(dist_hellingerfo, group = metadata_dffo$treatment)

plot(betadisper_resultfo)
anova_resfo <- anova(betadisper_resultfo)  # p-value 0.0001537

# Extract values
F_value <- anova_resfo$`F value`[1]
p_anova <- anova_resfo$`Pr(>F)`[1]

# Dispersion table
df_dispfo <- data.frame(sample = names(betadisper_resultfo$distances), distance = betadisper_resultfo$distances, group = metadata_dffo$treatment)

table_dispfo <- df_dispfo %>%
group_by(group) %>%
summarise(n = n(), mean_dispersion = mean(distance), sd = sd(distance), se = sd / sqrt(n),
.groups = "drop") %>%
mutate(F_value = F_value, p_anova = p_anova)

#Tukey post-hoc
tukey_resfo <- TukeyHSD(betadisper_resultfo)

tukey_tablefo <- as.data.frame(tukey_resfo$group)
tukey_tablefo$comparison <- rownames(tukey_tablefo)
rownames(tukey_tablefo) <- NULL

tukey_tablefo <- tukey_tablefo %>%
rename(diff = diff, lower = lwr, upper = upr, 'p_adj' = `p adj`)

write_xlsx(list(
"Dispersion-agri" = table_disp,
"Tukey-agri" = tukey_table,
"Dispersion-fo" = table_dispfo,
"Tukey-fo" = tukey_tablefo),
path = here("synthetic_soil/Results/dispersion_synthetic_16s.xlsx"))

#Graph beta-dispersion
kruskal.test(df_dispfo$distance ~ df_dispfo$group)
#p-value = 0.01335

dunndisp_fo<-dunnTest(distance ~ group, data = df_dispfo, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

lettres_dispfo <- data.frame(
treatment = c("10^-0", "10^-02", "10^-04", "10^-06", "10^-08", "ctl"),
lettre = c("a", "ab", "ab", "b", "b", "b"),
y = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1))

beta_dispfo<- ggplot(df_dispfo, aes(x = group, y = distance, fill = group, color=group)) +
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) +
geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2)+
scale_fill_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatmentfo, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_color_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatmentfo, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_x_discrete(labels=treatment_names)+ 
labs(x = "", y = "Distance to centroid") + theme_minimal() + 
theme( legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0)) + 
geom_text(data = lettres_dispfo, aes(x = treatment, y = y, label = lettre), inherit.aes = FALSE)


set.seed(18575748)  
permanova_fo <-adonis2(dist_hellingerfo ~ treatment, data = metadata_dffo, permutations = 999, by="terms", strata = metadata_dffo$block)

print(permanova_fo)
#          Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
#treatment  5   7.8523 0.34741 2.5553  0.001 ***
#Residual  24  14.7503 0.65259                  
#Total     29  22.6026 1.00000


permanovafo_out <- permanova_fo %>%
tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Variable")
write_xlsx(permanovafo_out, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/permanova_forest_synthetic_16S.xlsx")
```

# Raup-Crick
```{r}
ps_fo <- subset_samples(ps_fo, treatment != "ctl")

# Abundance
otu_rc <- as(otu_table(ps_fo), "matrix")

# In line
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_fo)) {
otu_rc <- t(otu_rc)}

# Remove sample with no reads
otu_rc <- otu_rc[rowSums(otu_rc) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

#Raup-Crick
set.seed(123)
dist_rc_fo <- raupcrick(comm = otu_rc, null = "r1", nsimul = 9999)

summary(as.vector(dist_rc_fo))
range(as.vector(dist_rc_fo))

#Align metadata with sample
metadatafo <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_fo))
metadatafo <- metadatafo[rownames(otu_rc), , drop = FALSE]

metadatafo$treatment <- factor(metadatafo$treatment)
metadatafo$block <- factor(metadatafo$block)

# betadisper
betadisper_rc_fo <- betadisper(dist_rc_fo, group = metadatafo$treatment)
plot(betadisper_rc_fo)
anova_res_rc <- anova(betadisper_rc_fo) #(p-value 0.02211 *

adonis2(dist_rc_fo ~ treatment, data = metadatafo, permutations = 999, by="terms", strata = metadatafo$block)
#          Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
#treatment  4  2.69680 0.86102 30.975  0.001 ***
#Residual  20  0.43532 0.13898                  
#Total     24  3.13211 1.00000 

```

## Linear model raup-crick-alpha
```{r}
library(vegan)

enzyme_fo_filtre <- div_enzyme %>%
filter(sample %in% metadatafo$sample) %>%
slice(match(metadatafo$sample, sample))

pcoa_rc <- cmdscale(dist_rc_fo, k = 5, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)

# Sample coordinate
site_scores_fo <- pcoa_rc$points

# ASVs Scores
asv_scores_fo <- wascores(site_scores_fo, otu_rc, expand = TRUE)
asv_scores_df_fo <- as.data.frame(asv_scores_fo) %>% rownames_to_column("ASV")

asv_table_fo <- asv_scores_df_fo %>%
left_join(asv_16s_mapping, by = "ASV")

top_asv_fo <- bind_rows(
asv_table_fo %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V1), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA1"),
asv_table_fo %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V2), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA2"),
asv_table_fo %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V3), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA3"),
asv_table_fo %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V4), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA4"),
asv_table_fo %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(V5), n = 10) %>% mutate(Axe = "PCoA5"))

write_xlsx(top_asv_fo,
path = "synthetic_soil/Results/topasv_rp_16S_forest_synthetic.xlsx")

pcoa_rc <- data.frame(
SampleID = metadatafo$sample,
PCoA1 = pcoa_rc$points[, 1],
PCoA2 = pcoa_rc$points[, 2],
PCoA3 = pcoa_rc$points[, 3],
PCoA4 = pcoa_rc$points[, 4],
PCoA5 = pcoa_rc$points[, 5],
treatment = metadatafo$treatment,
block = metadatafo$block,
shannon = enzyme_fo_filtre$Shannon,
observed = enzyme_fo_filtre$Observed,
protease = enzyme_fo_filtre$Protease,
bgluco = enzyme_fo_filtre$Bglucosidase,
deaminase = enzyme_fo_filtre$Desaminase,
ammonif = enzyme_fo_filtre$Ammonification,
nitrif = enzyme_fo_filtre$Nitrification)

X <- as.matrix(pcoa_rc[, grep("PCoA", names(pcoa_rc))])
protease <- pcoa_rc$protease
bgluco <- pcoa_rc$bgluco
des <- pcoa_rc$deaminase
ammonif <-pcoa_rc$ammonif
nitrif<-  pcoa_rc$nitrif
shannon <- pcoa_rc$shannon
obs <- pcoa_rc$observed
block <- pcoa_rc$block

#Protease
prot_lm_bfo <- lm(sqrt(protease)~ X +obs)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(prot_lm_bfo)

#Normality of residual
shapiro.test(residuals(prot_lm_bfo))
#p-value = 0.09705

#homoscedasticité
bptest(prot_lm_bfo)
#p-value= 0.6949

summary(prot_lm_bfo)
#p-value 0.7709

#Bgluco
bgluco_lm_bfo <- lm(bgluco~ X + obs)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(bgluco_lm_bfo)

#Normality of residual
shapiro.test(residuals(bgluco_lm_bfo))
#p-value = 0.1735

#homoscedasticity
bptest(bgluco_lm_bfo)
#p-value= 0.1234

summary(bgluco_lm_bfo)
#p-value 0.4708

#Deaminases
des_lm_bfo <- lm(des~ X + obs )

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(des_lm_bfo)

#Normality of residual
shapiro.test(residuals(des_lm_bfo))
#p-value = 0.1308

#homoscedasticity
bptest(des_lm_bfo)
#p-value= 0.02434

summary(des_lm_bfo)
#p-value 0.1394

#ammonification
ammonif_lm_bfo <- lm(ammonif~ X+ obs)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(ammonif_lm_bfo)

#Normality of residual
shapiro.test(residuals(ammonif_lm_bfo))
#p-value = 0.4476

#homoscedasticity
bptest(ammonif_lm_bfo)
#p-value= 0.05979

summary(ammonif_lm_bfo)
#p-value 0.004571
#Axe 1 et 4

#Nitrification
nitrif_lm_bfo <- lm(sqrt(nitrif)~ X +obs)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(nitrif_lm_bfo)

#Normality of residual
shapiro.test(residuals(nitrif_lm_bfo))
#p-value = 0.1058

#homoscedasticity
bptest(nitrif_lm_bfo)
#p-value= 0.6459

summary(nitrif_lm_bfo)
#p-value 0.00402
#Axe 1 3 et obs

# Models list 
model_rcfo <- list(
protease = prot_lm_bfo,
bgluco = bgluco_lm_bfo,
des = des_lm_bfo,
ammonif = ammonif_lm_bfo,
nitrif = nitrif_lm_bfo)

# Extract coefficient
coef_tablefo <- bind_rows(lapply(names(model_rcfo), function(name) {
tidy(model_rcfo[[name]]) %>%
mutate(response = name)})) %>%
dplyr::select(response, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value)

# Statistic
model_statsfo <- bind_rows(lapply(names(model_rcfo), function(name) {
glance(model_rcfo[[name]]) %>%
mutate(response = name)})) %>%
dplyr::select(response, r.squared, adj.r.squared, statistic, p.value, AIC, BIC)


#Clean
coef_tablefo <- coef_tablefo %>%
dplyr::select(response, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value)

model_statsfo <- model_statsfo %>%
dplyr::select(response, r.squared, adj.r.squared, statistic, p.value, AIC, BIC)

write_xlsx(list(
Coefficients = coef_tablefo,
Model_Summary = model_statsfo),
path = "synthetic_soil/Results/lm_rp_obs_summaries_16S_forest_synthetic.xlsx")
```
